space.description: 'model' (design space, US survey feet) or a sheet id/name (paper space, inches), e.g. 'SH-001' or 'C-101'

layer.description: layer name; defaults to the current layer

kind.description: linear (measured along one axis), aligned (the true distance between two points), angular (the angle at a vertex), radius, diameter, or arc_length

line_point.description: where the dimension line goes -- the point a drafter drags to. It also settles what is being measured: clear above or below a pair of points is a horizontal dimension and out to the side a vertical one; on an angular dimension it picks which of the four angles between the rays is meant; on a radius or diameter it is where the text sits (inside the circle draws across it, outside draws a leader)

p1.description: first measured point (angular: a point out along the first ray; radius/diameter: the point on the circle the arrow touches, default: toward line_point)

p2.description: second measured point (arc_length: the far end, measured counter-clockwise from p1)

center.description: angular: the vertex. radius/diameter/arc_length: the centre of the circle

radius.description: radius of the circle being measured; or give of_entity

of_entity.description: measure this entity: a line/polyline/arc end to end (linear, aligned), or an arc/circle's own geometry (radius, diameter, arc_length). Ids come from find_entities and hit_test; reference elements are 'SURVEY:LN-001'

from_entity.description: measure from a point on this entity (angular: one of the two lines whose intersection is the vertex)

to_entity.description: measure to a point on this entity (angular: the other line)

from_at.description: where on from_entity: start|mid|end or a fraction 0-1 (default mid)

to_at.description: where on to_entity: start|mid|end or a fraction 0-1 (default mid)

rotation_deg.description: linear: the direction measured along (0 = horizontal, 90 = vertical). Omit and the engine reads it off line_point

text.description: override the measured value ('' hides the text entirely); omit to let the number follow the geometry

prefix.description: before the number; defaults to the kind's own (R=, Ø, L=)

unit_format.description: feet (120.00'), feet_inches (12'-6") or decimal (no unit mark). Default: feet in model space, decimal on a sheet. An angular dimension reads DMS (28°15'30") unless this is 'decimal'

arrow.description: terminator: arrow (default), tick (the oblique civil slash), dot, or none

arrow_size.description: arrowhead length (default 1.2 x the text height)

text_gap.description: gap between the dimension line and the text (default 0.5 x the text height)

extension_offset.description: gap between the measured point and its extension line (default 0.6 x the text height)

extension_beyond.description: how far an extension line runs past the dimension line (default 1.0 x the text height)

text_height.description: text height in space units; defaults to the annotation scale in model space, 0.10 in on a sheet

measure_scale.description: multiplier from drawn length to reported length (AutoCAD DIMLFAC). 1 by default; on a sheet, set it to the viewport's plot scale (50 for 1"=50') to dimension in model feet
